rules.text: Use only the five palette colours: Snow Flurry #E9FACA, Ultramarine #3900F4 and Electric Pink #FFBFED, with black and white for contrast.
Text on Snow Flurry and Electric Pink is always black; white text fails there (1.1:1 and 1.5:1). Ultramarine and black take white text (8.5:1 and 21:1); black text on Ultramarine fails (2.5:1).
The logo is type only: the AKG wordmark with ®. Keep 1x clear space on every side (1x = one third of the wordmark height) and never set it smaller than 32px tall.
Headings are set in caps in the grotesk; copy, labels and pills are in the letter-spaced mono.
Technical symbols sit inside headlines the way creators drop emojis into sentences: one engineered glyph per headline, never social clipart.
Illustrations are shiny metallic 3D objects made of basic geometric shapes, accompanied by simple clean line illustrations for contrast.
Labels sit in outline pills with fully round ends; cards are flat with one corner cut at 45°.
